basis: Original reconstructed mature body and plain1904 civilian coat/waistcoat/shirt-front/collar/trousers/lowshoes. All cuts, dimensions, materials, color, height, body shape and actions are conjectural; no source-matched wardrobe, historical personal outfit or likeness. Existing identity is attested; depiction remains reconstructed.

canonical_derivations.shoe_grounding: translate each reviewed shoe by negative source minY
canonical_derivations.body_visibility: mask source body faces crossing below grounded shoe top; prune unused vertices

skin_texture.roughness_basis: Reconstructed engineering value, not measured from a period person or calibrated capture.
skin_texture.identity_basis: Cleared reusable generic skin atlas; not a likeness, attested complexion, or source identifying any named/reconstructed resident.
skin_texture.uv_status: Source atlas and UV registration viewed in source diagnostics; final Blender export/LOD render validation remains outstanding.
skin_texture.age_limit: The selected atlas is labeled young by its source; used only as a cleared reusable engineering color map. It is not age-matched mature skin, measured complexion or a named likeness.

hair_component.appearance_basis: Shared cleared CC0 short04 source fitted to the actual mature-body engineering input; hair, part and color are reconstructed choices. No period hairstyle attestation, age-specific hair acceptance or individual likeness.
